_notes.paths: relative to the directory site.mjs runs in; {lang} is replaced by each 2-letter language (missing files fall back to defaultLanguage)
_notes.host: one-level subdomain of a Cloudflare zone, not www or m
_notes.out: folder that receives public/ (generated) and wrangler.jsonc
_notes.admobPublisherIds: each becomes 'google.com, pub-..., DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0' in app-ads.txt; empty = no app-ads.txt
_notes.theme: #RRGGBB; bg1 top of the hero, bg2 main background, bg3 deepest, glow halo, accent pills and buttons, ink text and footer
_notes.fonts: optional ttf/otf/woff2; display for titles (800), body (500) and bodyBold (700); an OFL/LICENSE file next to them is copied
_notes.images: icon 512 px PNG; hero = raw home screenshot (shown in the phone); shots = captioned store screenshots; og = feature graphic
_notes.texts: one object per language; features = [emoji, title, one or two sentences]
_notes.rating: content rating shown as a pill, or empty
_notes.cloudflareAccountId: only when the Cloudflare login has several accounts

en.title: Hikelog — Your hikes, mapped offline
en.description: Record your hikes offline and keep every trail in one place.
en.tagline: Record your hikes offline and keep every trail in one place.
features: Download a region once and follow your track without signal.
Distance, climb and pace for every hike, week after week.
Pin photos to the exact spot where you took them.
en.note: Hikelog is free and contains ads: a full-screen ad may appear after you save a hike, at most once every 3 minutes. No banners. In English and French.
